**P2 — Recover executions whose invoke response is lost**

Lambda may accept the invocation even when all CLI attempts ultimately fail. This path records only `REQUEST_FAILED`; `stop()` then has no ARN, and `collect()` ignores the artifact, leaving a silent execution running and uncollected. Reconcile failures using the deterministic durable execution name, persist any recovered ARN, and include it in cleanup and collection. Add coverage where every response fails after acceptance.
